name: path_hygiene

storage.rationale: The safeguard creates no files of its own. It rewrites a marked region inside the invoking user's pre-existing shell startup files, which the operator owns and which are not Vrooli state.

description: Keep ~/.vrooli/bin on the interactive PATH exactly once and first, and report duplicate PATH entries or a shadowing vrooli binary
notes: Retired per-scenario CLI installers appended an unguarded PATH line to ~/.bashrc each time they ran; one host accumulated 105 such lines across eight installers, yielding a 236-entry PATH with 17 unique directories. The managed block is delimited by markers so a rewrite replaces it instead of appending another copy, and it strips-then-prepends so ~/.vrooli/bin stays ahead of a stale `go install` copy regardless of what later startup files prepend.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
